description: PLANNED for OpenVibe.Website Connect (audience openvibe.website, owner or granted app): replay one captured request through the same share (POST /api/v1/shares/:id/requests/:rid/replay). Replay is allowed only while the share and its tunnel are active and only to that share's own local target; it never becomes a general proxy and never changes the share's policy. The replay is audited as a new request with its own request_id.
